HowItWorks.subtitle: A decentralized ecosystem connecting everyday citizens with verified professionals to hold public infrastructure spending accountable.
HowItWorks.step1_desc: CivicSpend automatically scans government databases, procurement portals, and news sources daily using our Gemini AI Radar to find new infrastructure projects and their claimed budgets. Citizens can also manually report projects ongoing in their local communities.
HowItWorks.step2_desc: Once a project is listed, citizens on the ground take photos and submit field notes of the actual construction progress. You don't even need an account to participate—our system uses secure device caching to allow frictionless voting and evidence uploading while preventing spam.
HowItWorks.step2_quote: "Only the foundation has been laid. No active workers on site since Tuesday."
HowItWorks.step3_desc: The community reviews the uploaded evidence and votes on its accuracy. When a project receives enough upvotes (reaching the Community Verified status), it is escalated to our network of professional oracles.
HowItWorks.step4_desc: Verified professionals (like Civil Engineers or Quantity Surveyors) authenticate via the Expert Dashboard. They review the citizen evidence and cryptographically sign a discrepancy report, permanently locking the Verified Physical Value into our Supabase database.
HowItWorks.cta_desc: Start by browsing the community feed, uploading evidence to an ongoing project, or using the AI Radar to discover new ones.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.p1_desc: Welcome to CivicSpend. We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring that your personal data is handled in a safe and responsible manner. This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our platform to track, report, and audit public infrastructure projects.
Privacy.p2_desc: When you use CivicSpend, we may collect the following types of information:
Privacy.p2_li1: Device Information: We use device fingerprints (such as local storage or cookies) to ensure fair voting and prevent duplicate submissions without requiring you to create an account.
Privacy.p2_li2: Uploaded Evidence: Photos, notes, and geographical locations you submit to verify project status.
Privacy.p2_li3: Expert Credentials: For professionals acting as Oracles, we verify your professional identity or wallet address to cryptographically sign audits.
Privacy.p3_desc: Your information is used strictly to maintain the integrity of the platform:
Privacy.p3_li1: To track community consensus and prevent vote manipulation.
Privacy.p3_li2: To display verified public infrastructure evidence to the community.
Privacy.p3_li3: To establish accountability and transparency through expert cryptographic signatures.
Privacy.p4_desc: CivicSpend is built on transparency. All evidence and project data submitted to the platform becomes public record. However, we do not sell your personal device data or professional wallet credentials to third parties. We use industry-standard security measures (including decentralized ledgers and secure databases) to protect against unauthorized access.
Privacy.p5_desc: If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at privacy@civicspend.ng.

Terms.p3_desc: You agree to use the Platform only for lawful purposes. You agree not to take any action that might compromise the security of the Platform, render the Platform inaccessible to others, or otherwise cause damage to the Platform or its Content. Specifically, you agree not to:

Terms.p3_li2: Attempt to bypass device fingerprinting to manipulate consensus voting (upvotes/downvotes).
Terms.p3_li3: Use the platform to defame, harass, or threaten individuals or government entities.
Terms.p4_desc: Professionals accessing the Expert Audit dashboard must provide accurate credentials.
